title: Drum and Bass
tagline: Breakneck breakbeats and deep bass built for soundsystems and clubs.
summary: Drum and bass grew from UK rave culture through the transformation of breakbeat samples into fast, syncopated rhythms. Deep bass and detailed production anchor a sound that ranges from atmospheric and melodic to fierce and minimal. Its scenes continue to evolve through DJs, producers, pirate radio, and club communities.

pillars.name: Goldie
pillars.why: Goldie's recordings and label work helped establish drum and bass as an ambitious album and club form.

pillars.name: LTJ Bukem
pillars.why: Bukem developed a spacious, melodic approach that became central to atmospheric drum and bass.

pillars.name: Roni Size
pillars.why: Roni Size brought inventive production and live instrumentation to a widely recognized Bristol drum-and-bass sound.
